n: Two-Way Professional Compact Loudspeaker for Life/Safety Applications (Control 25AV-LS)
d: Two-Way Professional Compact Loudspeaker for Life/Safety Applications

specs.label: Nominal Sensitivity
specs.value: 88dB, 1W at 1m (1kHz–10kHz, ave., at 8 ohm bypass mode); 76 dB, 1W at 4m per EN54-24 (100 Hz – 10 kHz, ave., 8 ohm bypass mode)

specs.label: Maximum SPL
specs.value: 107 dB @ 1m (3.3 ft) average, 113 dB peak, at 8 ohms bypass mode, 92 dB at 4 m (13.2 ft.) average, at 60W tap setting, measured

specs.label: Impedance
specs.value: 8 ohms (in bypass, position 5, mode) - tap 1: 667 ohms; tap 2: 333 ohms; tap 3: 166 ohms, tap 4: 82 ohms (typical)

specs.label: Drivers
specs.value: 130mm (5.25 in) with polypropylene coated paper cone withWeatherEdge surround, 25 mm (1 in) voicecoil on kapton former HF: 20mm (.75 in) titanium coated PEI

specs.label: Outdoor Capability
specs.value: Exceeds Mil Spec 810 for humidity, salt spray, temperature & UV, IEC 529 IP-x5 splashproof rating
